officialSeasonAndReferenceSpecs.evidence: HEAD 2025/26 Hardgoods Workbook maps article 313365 to Worldcup Rebels e.SLR. It lists 149/156/163/170 cm, reference sidecut 123/66/107 mm and radius 11.2 m at 163 cm, LYT PR Base, and package binding 100911 PR 11 GW Brake [G] 78 mm. The workbook provides one reference-size geometry row, not a full per-length table.

perLengthSpecsCrossCheck.evidence: Sport-Bittl's exact 313365 product page lists all four length-specific sidecuts and radii, identifies the 25/26 PR 11 GripWalk package, and reports a weight field of 1830 g without defining whether the binding is included; weight is therefore not copied into the seed. The HEAD workbook independently confirms article, season, length range, reference geometry, plate and binding family. Heise's exact 2025/26 article 313365 comparison page reproduces all four sidecuts and radii.

chinaMarketplaceLeadAudit.listingText: 海德（HEAD）25/26新品滑雪板双板套装男女中级小回转雪板雪鞋 SLR包杖六件套 e.SLR313365-100911+EDGE 90 156cm
chinaMarketplaceLeadAudit.articleNumberEvidence: The indexed listing title explicitly includes ski article 313365 and binding article 100911; the title also identifies an EDGE 90 boot and a six-piece bundle.
chinaMarketplaceLeadAudit.directPageStatus: The direct product page returned a browser compatibility prompt; no variant-level price or stock could be verified.
chinaMarketplaceLeadAudit.decision: Record only as a Chinese-market exact-board/binding bundle lead. It includes additional boot/accessory components and cannot be used as the comparable price of the ski plus PR 11 GW binding alone. Do not change the seed CNY reference without a readable current variant price, availability, and bundle contents.

priceAudit.seedPriceMarket: Germany price comparison listing for HEAD article 313365 + PR 11 GW binding
priceAudit.availabilityAtCapture: Price comparison page marked the EUR 349.90 offer as in stock.
priceAudit.shippingAtCapture: EUR 29.90 shown for advance payment; excluded from converted product price.
limitations: The CNY amount is converted from a German regional listing, not a Chinese retail quote or landed price.
The comparison page's displayed offer update date is 2026-09-13; although the offer is shown in stock at retrieval, its price and inventory can change.
The JD exact-board/binding lead is an additional boot/accessory bundle with unreadable current price and stock, so it is not comparable and does not replace the regional reference.

remainingUnknowns: No current, readable China-market price and availability for a 313365 + 100911 ski-and-binding set were confirmed.
The retailer's 1830 g weight figure does not define whether it includes the binding; omit from the seed until weight basis is explicit.
The official workbook gives a 163 cm reference radius; the other three length radii are supported by exact-article retailer/comparison pages, not an official HEAD per-length table.
Image display/licensing permission for the HEAD CDN product image is not verified.
